query: How might one acquire a diminished TDS endorsement in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
Lower TDS Certificate Application:
To apply for a lower TDS certificate in Tamil Nadu, submit Form 13 to the Income Tax Department. You can download the form from the official income tax website or visit the nearest Income Tax Office. Attach required documents, such as PAN card and income proof.
answer: To acquire a diminished TDS (Tax Deduction Scheme) endorsement in Tamil Nadu, one typically needs to meet eligibility criteria set by the state government, which may include having a certain number of years of experience in the field, holding relevant qualifications, and possibly passing an examination.
